title: Virgo made a family binder
old_caption: Virgo made a tabbed, laminated family binder. The date read it twice and remembered Aunt Bea's tea and the dog's birthday. Is studying for someone the most romantic move?

title: Libra has to pick a pie
old_caption: Two grandmas, two pies, one Libra swinging like a pendulum. The Aries date found the only right answer: seconds of both. Pumpkin or cherry, which side are you on?

title: Scorpio hid the baby photos
old_caption: Scorpio hid the baby album under a cushion. Mom had copies. One tiny dinosaur photo later, the date traded a tiny lobster. Would you show your baby pictures this early?

title: Sagittarius said "my family's chill"
old_caption: Sag promised a chill family and opened the door on a conga line. Then Sag offered a code word for a quiet break, no questions asked. What's your exit word?

title: Capricorn fixes the whole house
old_caption: Capricorn fixed the lights, the wobbly table and the squeaky door before sitting down once. Grandma had to say it: you're home. Who needs to hear that this year?

title: Aquarius warns about the traditions
old_caption: Dessert first, gifts wrapped in star maps, and good night to the moon from the roof. The Leo didn't just fit in, it started a new one. What's your family's weirdest tradition?

title: Pisces brings someone home
old_caption: Pisces cried at the wreath, the doormat and every hallway photo. The Capricorn date handed out tissues, then let one perfect tear fall too. Who cries with you?

title: The seating chart
old_caption: Libra tried three seats for its date: next to the baby photos, beside the loudest laugh in the house, and across from a toy drum. Option four was obvious all along. Who did you get seated next to last year?

title: So what do you do?
old_caption: Virgo answered the uncle with a full slide deck. What actually worked was soup. Turns out the question was never a test, just a door. What do you say when a relative asks what you do?

title: The kids' table
old_caption: Sagittarius got sent to the kids' table and won the crayon finals. Aries lasted one round of weather talk before squeezing into the tiniest chair. Which table are you picking this year?
